name: Weather Order Notice
description: Send-once ledger for severe-weather order notices: one row per (order, weather notice episode, audience) push attempted by the hourly order-notice job (src/weather_notice/order_notices.py). Rows are written by the scheduler only; deleting a row would re-notify.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Order name. Data (not Link) so this ledger composes even on shells without the orders module.

fields.label: Weather Notice
fields.description: The weather module's Severe Weather Warning record id (stable per episode; the record lives control-side).
